qs.q:
Student Accommodation — Which person says that they lived in a house/flat…

A=Alec (hilltop flat with view, deal with owner, lower rent, part-time job, dissertation)
B=Bella (cheap, terrible condition, demolished now, felt completely free, independence)
C=Caleb (fabulous apartment, everything new, close to faculty, left when flatmate moved)
D=Doris (caretaker arrangement, friend of father's flat, free to live there, partying neighbours)
E=Edgar (big flat, too many visitors, chaotic parties, neighbours complaining, moved out)
F=Fiona (tiny one-room, cheap, bad area, miserable, passing trains, gangs outside)

0. where they did not pay the full rent? [A=Alec: 'deal where I paid a lower rent']
1. where they felt lonely?
2. which they could not afford?
3. which was near a railway line?
4. for free?
5. in a convenient location?
6. in a noisy neighbourhood?
7. where they felt almost claustrophobic?
8. which was new?
9. which has been demolished?
10. which required a lot of work?
11. with old neighbours?
12. where it was difficult to study?
items: 3 — which was near a railway line?
10 — which required a lot of work?
12 — where it was difficult to study?

qs.q:
Jimmy Stuart – Former Prisoner

"Mum still blames this [the neighbourhood] for everything that happened to her only child."

Jimmy's mother believes he became a criminal because he…
A lived in an extremely poor area.
B was raised in a single-parent family.
C made the decision to live such a life.
D was unsuccessful at school.
opts: lived in an extremely poor area.
was raised in a single-parent family.
made the decision to live such a life.

"Initially, I obsessively worked out. I was able to do hundreds of sit-ups."

D did a lot of exercise.

Jimmy Stuart

"I couldn't take it up because my record prevented me from obtaining a visa, which was a bitter disappointment, even more so than remaining single and having no kids."

What does Jimmy regret most about his criminal past?
A Wasting seven years of his life.
B The limitations on his professional development.
C Being unable to travel abroad freely.
D Not having a successful relationship.
opts: Wasting seven years of his life.
The limitations on his professional development.
Being unable to travel abroad freely.

Overcoming my fear of alligators

"Sons of hunters have become the eco-tour guides of the reserve. (19) ___. He explained that in the pantanal people know nature well and can catch most animals by hand."

A But each time they saw me coming they were quickly in the water and out of sight.
B Before attempting to cross it, Paulo went to check its depth.
C As a result, they are extremely sensitive to movement.
D Today the only animals hunted are the wild boars, because they destroy all the agriculture.
E So I continued to hold it in my hands.
F It would take a few more encounters for me to lose my fear.
G They catch the most unique animals for the pleasure of tourists and, after a few photos, release them unharmed back into the wilderness.
H As usual, it dived instantly at our approach, and disappeared in the depths of the green muddy pool.
opts: A — But each time they saw me, they were in the water and out of sight.
B — Before attempting to cross it, Paulo went to check its depth.
C — As a result, they are extremely sensitive to movement.
D — Today the only animals hunted are the wild boars.
E — So I continued to hold it in my hands.
F — It would take a few more encounters for me to lose my fear.
G — They catch the most unique animals for tourists and release them unharmed.
H — As usual, it dived instantly at our approach.
